# Content signals (contentsignals.org, IETF aipref). Values are yes/no;
# omitting a signal means neither granting nor restricting it.
#   search    building a search index and returning links and excerpts.
#             Does NOT cover AI-generated summaries.
#   ai-input  feeding content to a model at answer time (RAG, grounding,
#             generative search answers).
#   ai-train  training or fine-tuning a model.
#
# All three are yes. Keep Cloudflare AI Crawl Control matching this —
# declaring one thing here and enforcing the opposite at the edge is the
# failure mode worth avoiding.
